title: Mask Adoption Dynamics
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and wear face masks over time under social influence, information exposure, availability, cost, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: social_influence_contact
interactions.description: Persons interact over a social network; observing masked peers shifts beliefs and reduces adoption thresholds.

interactions.name: purchase_masks
interactions.description: Person buys masks from Retailer subject to price and stock; acquisition enables wearing behavior.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_event
interactions.description: PublicHealthAuthority mandates mask use; Places enforce with probability; noncompliance may incur fines influencing future compliance.

interactions.name: media_exposure
interactions.description: MediaChannel broadcasts messages that adjust belief_in_efficacy and risk_perception; misinformation may decrease adoption.

interactions.name: place_based_contact
interactions.description: Persons meet at Places (workplaces, transit, etc.), where mask wearing affects observability and social proof; compliance may be required.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of persons wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Days required to reach specified adoption thresholds (e.g., 50%, 80%).

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate achieved during the simulation.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_after_policy
metrics.description: Average adoption rate in a window after mandates are lifted, indicating persistence.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption attributable to policy (with vs. without mandate or pre- vs. post-mandate).

metrics.name: inequality_of_adoption
metrics.description: Variation in adoption across demographic or degree groups (e.g., Gini or between-group differences).

metrics.name: churn_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which previously adopting individuals stop wearing masks.

metrics.name: cumulative_masked_person_days
metrics.description: Sum over time of the number of persons wearing masks, measuring total protective behavior.

metrics.name: sensitivity_to_misinformation
metrics.description: Change in adoption metrics as misinformation_prevalence varies.

validation_criteria.name: bounded_adoption
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate remains within [0,1] at all times; no numerical instability.

validation_criteria.name: monotonic_response_to_price
validation_criteria.description: Higher mask_cost should not increase adoption holding other factors constant (negative price elasticity).

validation_criteria.name: policy_monotonicity
validation_criteria.description: Increasing mandate_enforcement_level should not reduce adoption in otherwise identical conditions.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_check
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate changes fall below a small epsilon over a trailing window, indicating steady state when no new shocks are introduced.
